mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising federal funds rate and a declining unemployment rate signals an overheating economy where monetary tightening is insufficient to cool demand, leading to elevated inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in housing starts above 1.2 million units signals strong consumer demand for housing and associated economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST exceeds 1.2 million, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 100.0 signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain resilience, which supports corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 4.0%, it triggers a monetary policy response that increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0% y/y, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls exceeding 200,000 jobs signals accelerating labor market strength and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-recession recovery when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising housing starts (HOUST) and rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong demand for housing and robust manufacturing output, indicating a synchronized economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO are rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
